drug_information.description: Alprazolam is a benzodiazepine psychotropic substance listed under the NDPS framework. Unauthorized possession, manufacture, sale, transport, storage and distribution are prohibited.

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Prohibition of Certain Operations
applicable_ndps_sections.applicability: Prohibits unauthorized operations involving narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances.

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Punishment for Contravention in Relation to Psychotropic Substances
applicable_ndps_sections.applicability: Applies to offences involving psychotropic substances, with punishment depending on the applicable quantity category.

storage_guidelines: Store seized material in tamper-evident sealed evidence containers.
Label each exhibit with a unique evidence ID.
investigation_guidelines: Secure the premises and prevent contamination.
Photograph and document seized material and laboratory equipment.
Collect representative samples following applicable procedures.
Record weight, packaging and identifying marks.
Document laboratory equipment and raw materials.
Preserve financial and property records where relevant.
Send samples to an authorized forensic laboratory.
officer_precautions: Avoid direct contact with unknown powders or pharmaceutical substances.
Use appropriate precautions when entering suspected clandestine laboratories.
